_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 68: 12-14 May 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a black cloak and gauze and this webbing coming off his hand as things that were agreed upon, that the Lord said this is from May the 25th to the 4th and to pray for that timeframe, and that he saw the tomb of the unknown soldier and flowers.
mentions.quote: The Lord said, This is from May the 25th to the 4th
mentions.falsify_match: Something notable in that eleven day window, which spans Memorial Day.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing. The window is precise and the content is not.

mentions.claim_text: He says her office was raided by the FBI while President Trump was out of the country and they took the JFK files and whatever else, mentions the CIA, and says he remembers seeing a coup coming and the 25th Amendment.
mentions.quote: I remember I saw a coup coming. I saw a coup the 25th am
mentions.falsify_match: A reported raid offered as fulfilment of the coup word. Both the raid and his earlier tellings are checkable.
mentions.falsify_miss: The earlier tellings do not describe a raid, and a raid is not a 25th Amendment removal.

mentions.claim_text: He says there are holes in the Statue of Liberty and they try to be holes with fire in it, but that this is not literal and is symbolic, and that this would try to come on the land.
mentions.quote: there's holes in the Statue of Liberty. But this is symbolic
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as he frames it: he marks the image symbolic himself, so no physical event is required.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says the main thing is the main thing and they pray for humility and for God to keep his hand on this man because he believes he has things for him to do, and that Jesus stood right there in his house and warned him about this in January.
mentions.quote: Jesus stood right there in my house and he warned me about this in January
mentions.falsify_match: A January telling of the warning, which would be in this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such telling. A bodily appearance in his house is the strongest source claim he makes.

mentions.claim_text: He reads that in the drought they are in, they believe that by the end of summer if things do not change they will be in the drought of 1610, which was the breaking point when nobody could grow anything, and mentions a story about the Hoover Dam.
mentions.quote: by the end of summer we will be in the drought of 1610
mentions.falsify_match: Drought conditions reaching that historical benchmark by the end of summer.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. The benchmark and the deadline both come from the article rather than from a sighting.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told them back in 2023, that there is no water, repeated three times, and that they heard it three times, that the Lord said a new dust bowl was coming, that he saw a new dust bowl, and mentions the farmers.
mentions.quote: There is no water. And we heard it three times
mentions.falsify_match: Dust bowl conditions in American farmland, with the 2023 telling near the start of this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: No dust bowl in three years.

mentions.claim_text: He reads that an expert now suggests it is possible it may be more contagious than thought, checks that he read it right and is told it is about close contact with someone having symptoms, and says he has prayed over this virus a quarter of the time.
mentions.quote: expert now suggests it's possible it may be more contagious than thought
mentions.falsify_match: A real outbreak report offered against the plague material.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a: the report is public and he is reading it rather than forecasting it.

mentions.claim_text: He says it would try to affect the election and do things in 2028, that they are in 2026 so they are early, that it was the end of 2027 going into 2028 like they did with covid, and that he believes this is a trial run and does not believe this is it.
mentions.quote: I believe this is a trial run. I don't believe this is it
mentions.falsify_match: A major outbreak in late 2027 or 2028 affecting the election.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A trial run is the device that lets a present outbreak confirm the claim without discharging it.

mentions.claim_text: He mentions recession, says the new guy took over and is supposed to be sworn in by the end of the week and to take Jerome Powell's job, that Powell is jobless and looking for a new job, and that the new guy takes over while his eyes get as big as saucers.
mentions.quote: Jerome Powell's jobless. He's supposed to be looking for a new job
mentions.falsify_match: The Fed chair leaving office in May 2026, which is what the published term end says.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. In December he put this departure in January; it is happening in May, which is what watch-may-interest-rates said.

mentions.claim_text: He says he just thinks it is interesting and watches, and reads that Jerome Powell's term as Fed chair ends Thursday May 15th with Kevin to be confirmed, noting the alien thing is also on Thursday and this is on Thursday.
mentions.quote: Jerome Powell term as Fed chair ends Thursday May 15th
mentions.falsify_match: A real dated transition. His December word said watch May concerning interest rates, which lands, and separately said Powell would be out in January, which did not.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He asks how old the Statue of Liberty is because he sees a Statue of Liberty, says France gave it to them and is confirmed, is told it is 139 years old with a birthday of October 28, and says he sees gifts coming from nations.
mentions.quote: I see gifts coming from nations
mentions.falsify_match: Gifts from other nations around the statue's anniversary.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The anniversary date is looked up on air rather than seen.

mentions.claim_text: He says they were given and had encased it in lead underneath the ground in a bunker, that the Lord said they cannot see it with these sniffers, and that he saw big noses which is symbolic of something flying through the sky.
mentions.quote: they had encased it in lead underneath the ground in a bunker
mentions.falsify_match: Nuclear or radiological material shielded from detection.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He glosses the noses as symbolic himself, which is the right instinct.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is being real with them and is not going to add to or take away from anything he has seen, that he did not see Tulsa, that the Lord said to pray over oil refineries in America, and that they pray over Tuttle and the Houston area and are still praying over Louisiana.
mentions.quote: I'm not going to add to or take away from anything I've seen
mentions.falsify_match: Refinery incidents at the named places.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The restraint is the point: he refuses to add his own city to the list because he did not see it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is looking for it because he saw something that looked like a twelve foot tall creature that will be talked about in the days ahead, and notes that people talk about Sasquatch and the thing that happened in Miami a couple of years ago.
mentions.quote: a 12-foot tall creature that will be talked about in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: A widely discussed sighting of a large humanoid creature.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He supplies the comparison cases himself, which are already circulating.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord tells them to pray over these timeframes, and reads that the FBI stopped four terrorist attack plots in December of 2025 alone and arrested four members of a far-left anti-government group on the 21st and the 29th.
mentions.quote: The FBI stopped four terrorist attacks plots in December of 2025 alone
mentions.falsify_match: Four real disrupted plots, dated, offered as what the December prayers accomplished.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a: the arrests are a matter of record and the attribution to prayer is the claim.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of drones and says he saw major disruption coming against the American people for New Year's Eve, specifically about New York Times Square, that here is one that was completely stopped, and that they did not announce it to the people until now and he does not know why.
mentions.quote: I saw major disruption coming for New Year's Eve specifically about Times Square
mentions.falsify_match: A disrupted Times Square plot, now reported, against his December prayers over exactly that target. Both are checkable and this is one of the stronger fulfilment claims in the corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: The reported plot is not about Times Square or New Year's Eve.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over the month of May and over their country, that there be no plots or plans for a Red Dawn experience, and mentions fertilizer concerning Timothy McVeigh style trucks and vans and huge fertilizer barrels, saying the fertilizer the Lord showed them is still out there.
mentions.quote: huge fertilizer barrels to find all this fertilizer. It's still out there
mentions.falsify_match: A fertiliser bomb plot uncovered.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Still out there means the claim persists indefinitely without a discharge condition.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that he sees Macron and the man over England and the royals and the lady, that they want to bring forth this new world order and agenda 2030, and that they want war over their area.
mentions.quote: they want to bring forth this new world order
mentions.falsify_match: A European push toward supranational governance.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Word for word the same as the 17 April telling.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is interesting because he saw four, asks when Trump said this and is told May 8th, and reads that on May 8th Trump announced a surprise three day ceasefire in the Russia Ukraine war and says he helped pass something.
mentions.quote: May 8th, Trump announces surprise 3-day ceasefire in Russia Ukraine war
mentions.falsify_match: A real dated announcement, matched to a number he says he saw.
mentions.falsify_miss: The number four does not correspond to a three day ceasefire, and the mention records that.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of major stuff in Florida and some other states to make sure the blue will not win, asks whether they will see more of that and answers yes, and says he told them political theatre will really get busy in June, July, August and September with a major event.
mentions.quote: political theater will really get busy in June, July, August, September
mentions.falsify_match: Sustained political conflict through the summer with a major event.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Political theatre in an election summer is close to unmissable.

mentions.claim_text: He says that as the tables turn it is drama in the media and asks what is going to fall, repeats that this is political theatre, asks where they are at, and says he will rededicate America on Sunday and asks what happens after that.
mentions.quote: He'll rededicate America and on Sunday
mentions.falsify_match: A public rededication of the nation on that Sunday.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not happen. A named act on a named day, five days out.
